description: Legal/compliance risk from displaying third-party image search results within a Curify product surface
detection_method: Legal/compliance review (Stage 2)
mitigation: Formal legal review of Google Custom Search API ToS before any implementation; do not proceed past Stage 2 without sign-off
owner_type: Legal/Compliance (company review required - not a legal conclusion this audit can make)

description: Copyright/display risk - showing copyrighted images without sufficient attribution or beyond permitted display terms
detection_method: Legal/compliance review; UI audit of attribution labeling
mitigation: Hotlink only, never proxy/re-host images; prominent source-domain badge on every external card (Merge/Ranking Spec, Deliverable 9)

description: Provider ToS risk - caching duration or usage pattern violates Google's Custom Search API terms
detection_method: Legal/compliance review of ToS text
mitigation: Confirm exact permitted cache TTL with compliance before finalizing the 7-day cache default (Failure/Cache/Cost spec)

description: Hotlinking risk - directly linking third-party-hosted images may violate hosting site's terms or cause blocked/rate-limited requests
detection_method: Monitoring of image load failure rates in staging/production
mitigation: Client-side broken-image fallback handling; monitor broken_image_or_link rate as a guardrail

description: Broken image risk - external images 404 or are removed after being cached
detection_method: broken_image_or_link field in Core-80 data and production observability
mitigation: Short-to-medium negative-result cache TTL, client-side graceful hide/skip of failed cards, no server-side proactive freshness re-verification (cost tradeoff)

description: Unsafe content risk - external image results contain content inappropriate for Curify's audience despite safe-search filtering
detection_method: safe_search_status field + manual review in Core-80 + production sampling
mitigation: Enable provider safe-search filtering by default; manual spot-check during Core-80 and staging; circuit breaker / kill switch as backstop

description: Query privacy risk - sending user search queries to a third-party API (Google) exposes query content to an external vendor
detection_method: Privacy/compliance review
mitigation: Log query_hash not raw query server-side (Failure/Cache/Cost spec); confirm what Google's API terms say about query data retention/use; company privacy review

description: LLM intent drift - the existing rewriter proposes a phrasing that diverges from user intent
likelihood: and that drifted query is then also sent to the external provider
detection_method: Medium
mitigation: Medium
rollout_stage: Test external search on the ORIGINAL query (Mode C) as well as rewritten query (Mode D/E) to isolate this risk; existing rewriter already has Path A/B guardrails against ungrounded rewrites (lib/searchRewrite.ts SYSTEM_PROMPT)

description: External result irrelevance - provider returns visually plausible but topically wrong results for ambiguous or niche queries
detection_method: manual_relevance scoring in Core-80
mitigation: Trigger threshold tuning (Deliverable 7); cap external result count; internal-first ranking policy (Deliverable 9)

description: Latency risk - external API call adds meaningful latency to the search response even with parallel execution
detection_method: latency_ms field in Core-80; P50/P95 guardrail in online test
mitigation: Promise.allSettled parallel execution (not sequential); timeout tuned from real Stage-3 measurements, not guessed

description: API cost risk - per-query billing on the external provider accumulates faster than budgeted
likelihood: especially if the trigger threshold is too loose
detection_method: Medium
mitigation: external_cost_estimate field; production cost tracking (currently does not exist for the LLM leg either - a preexisting gap)
owner_type: Trigger threshold gating (only call when genuinely thin); shared persistent cache (Redis) to avoid redundant calls; cost guardrail in online test

description: Quota exhaustion risk - traffic spikes cause the external provider's daily/monthly quota to be exceeded mid-experiment or mid-rollout
detection_method: Provider dashboard monitoring; circuit breaker state field
mitigation: Circuit breaker to stop calling on repeated failures; gradual traffic ramp (Stage 10) rather than instant 100 percent cutover

description: Provider outage risk - Google Custom Search API has an outage or degrades during production use
detection_method: Provider error rate monitoring
mitigation: Hard guarantee: external failure never removes internal results (Failure/Cache/Cost spec); Promise.allSettled ensures internal results render regardless
go_no_go_severity: LOW (if mitigation implemented correctly) otherwise BLOCKING

description: Click cannibalization risk - external results attract clicks that would otherwise have gone to internal (generatable) results
detection_method: High
mitigation: Internal-result CTR guardrail in online A/B test (Deliverable 13)
owner_type: Internal-first ranking, external results only fill genuine gaps (not shown when internal results are already sufficient), guardrail-based automatic stop if internal CTR regresses

description: External user exit risk - users click external results and leave Curify without returning (no funnel back into the product)
detection_method: High
mitigation: external_click to curify_create conversion tracking (Extension C's proposed metric); external bounce/exit rate guardrail
owner_type: Make with Curify CTA on every external card routing back into internal retrieval/generation; kill switch if conversion below 8 percent threshold per Extension C's proposal (value pending Stage 5 confirmation)

description: Reduced generation risk - the core CTR-up/Search-to-Generate-down failure pattern (Deliverable 13)
detection_method: Search-to-Generate Rate as PRIMARY online metric (not CTR alone)
mitigation: Explicit non-negotiable requirement that success is defined by Search-to-Generate Rate not CTR; automatic stop condition if this metric declines even while CTR rises

description: Misleading UI risk - a user mistakes an external result for a genuine Curify template/inspiration and expects internal actions (edit/remix) to work on it
detection_method: Manual UX review in Core-80 and staging QA; misleading-source rate metric
mitigation: Separate card component (not reused internal card) with hard-coded can_edit=false/can_generate=false constants (Deliverable 5); explicit source-domain badge and section label

description: Analytics attribution gap - missing search_id prevents reliable Search to Click to Generate measurement
likelihood: High (confirmed - search_id does not exist in the codebase today)
detection_method: Full-repo grep confirmed zero search_id references
mitigation: Build search_id generation and end-to-end threading as a P0 prerequisite before any online experiment (Instrumentation Plan)

description: Cache staleness risk - a cached external result set no longer reflects the provider's current top results
likelihood: or the cached image URL has since broken
detection_method: Low-Medium
mitigation: stale-result monitoring; broken_image_or_link rate
owner_type: 7-day TTL as a starting point (pending compliance confirmation per R03); client-side graceful degradation on load failure

description: Deduplication failure risk - the MVP dedup keys (canonical URL / normalized image URL / title plus domain) miss real duplicates (resized/re-hosted images) or internal/external content overlap
likelihood: High (a known limitation of the chosen MVP approach
detection_method: Low-Medium
mitigation: Manual review of merged_count vs visually-distinct count in Core-80
owner_type: Documented as an explicit MVP limitation (Deliverable 9); perceptual-hash/embedding-based dedup explicitly deferred to a later phase

description: Inability to reproduce results risk - offline Core-80 results are not reproducible if the external provider's live results change between evaluation runs (image search results are not static/versioned)
likelihood: High (structural - live search results change over time)
detection_method: Re-running a sample of Core-80 queries at a later date and comparing
mitigation: Document result-set timestamps alongside all Core-80 data; treat offline results as a point-in-time signal, not a permanent ground truth

description: Naming collision risk - internal miscommunication between this feature ('Hybrid Google rail') and the unrelated VIR doc's 'Hybrid' internal-retrieval-paradigm concept
detection_method: Cross-doc review (this audit identified the collision)
mitigation: Adopt an unambiguous internal name for this feature (e.g. External Fallback / Hybrid Google Rail) distinct from the VIR doc's Hybrid retriever terminology
